item.description:
About this item
🎁【Bonus 1 Soap Dish】: This toothbrush holder crafted by durable PP & TPR plastic sold with 1 self-draining soap dish + 2 bathroom cups as a set. Takes up minimal space, perfect size for your small bathroom.
🔸【Take Apart/Compact】: The electric toothbrush holder made with a removable bottom apartment to help easy to assemble and clean. Compact design to save space and lightweight helps to take up and periodical clean conveniently.
🔸【Anti-slip Strips/Smooth Corner】: 2 strips on the bottom provide the resistance from sliding away from the countertop. Each corner is smooth and sleek, with no scratches or cracks on edges to keep safe.
🔸【Stylish Toothbrush Holder】: Fit nicely for storing toothbrushes, toothpaste, electronic tooth brush, comb, tongue cleaners, and let your soap stay in place. 2 slots for holding cups to sit in it right side up or upside down to drain. Simple and modern color complements style to your bathroom vanity.
